sentences.zh: 当某个员工迎来最后一天，因为他们的音乐事业终于开始腾飞，

sentences.en: On the night before I laid off all 30 of my employees, I dreamed that my two children had perished,
sentences.zh: 在我解雇所有30名员工的前一天晚上，我做了一个梦，梦见我的两个孩子惨死，

sentences.en: buried alive in dirt, while I dug in the wrong place, just five feet away from where they were actually smothered.
sentences.zh: 被活埋在泥土中，而我却在错误的地方拼命挖着，离他们真正窒息的地方只有五英尺远。

sentences.en: I turned and spotted the royal blue heel of my youngest's socked foot poking out of the black soil, only after it was too late.
sentences.zh: 直到为时已晚，我转过身才发现黑色的泥土中露出了我小儿子穿着袜子的脚的皇家蓝色后跟。

sentences.en: For ten days, everyone in my orbit had been tilting one way one hour, the other the next.
sentences.zh: 整整十天，我生活圈里的每个人每小时都在左右摇摆，这一小时一个主意，下一小时又变卦。

sentences.en: Ten days of being waterboarded by the news, by tweets, by friends, by my waiters.
sentences.zh: 整整十天，我遭受着新闻、推特、朋友以及我的服务员们对我进行的水刑般的折磨。

sentences.en: Of being inundated by texts from fellow chefs and managers, former employees now at the helm of their own restaurants but still eager for guidance.
sentences.zh: 被同行主厨、经理以及那些如今自己掌管餐厅但仍渴望得到指导的前员工们发来的短信轰炸。

sentences.en: Of gentle but nervous pleas from my operations manager to consider signing up with a third-party delivery service like Caviar.
sentences.zh: 被我的运营经理温柔却焦虑的恳求所包围，劝我考虑签约像 Caviar 这样的第三方外卖服务。

sentences.en: Of being rattled even by my own wife, Ashley, and her anxious compulsion to act, to reduce our restaurant's operating hours, to close at 9 p.m., cut shifts.
sentences.zh: 甚至连我自己的妻子阿什莉也让我心神不宁，她那焦虑的行动冲动促使我们减少餐厅营业时间、晚上9点打烊、削减班次。

sentences.en: With no clear directive from any authority, public schools were still open.
sentences.zh: 没有任何官方的明确指示，公立学校仍然开着。

sentences.en: I spent those ten days sorting through the conflicting chatter, trying to decide what to do.
sentences.zh: 我花了整整十天时间在这些相互矛盾的杂音中理清头绪，试图决定该怎么做。

sentences.en: And now I understood, abruptly.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我突然明白了。

sentences.en: I would lay everybody off, even my wife.
sentences.zh: 我要解雇所有人，甚至包括我的妻子。

sentences.en: Prune, my Manhattan restaurant, would close at 11.59 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我的曼哈顿餐厅 Prune 将于

sentences.en: on March 15th.
sentences.zh: 3月15日晚上11点59分关闭。

sentences.en: I had only one piece of unemotional data to work with, the checking account balance.
sentences.zh: 我只有一个毫无感情色彩的数据可资利用，那就是支票账户余额。

sentences.en: If I triaged the collected sales tax that was sitting in its own dedicated savings account
sentences.zh: 如果我挪用存放在其专属储蓄账户中的已收营业税，

sentences.en: and left unpaid the stack of vendor invoices, I could fully cover this one last week of payroll.
sentences.zh: 并暂不支付那一叠供应商的发票，我就能全额支付这最后一周的工资。

sentences.en: By the time of the all-staff meeting after brunch that day, I knew I was right.
sentences.zh: 到了那天早午餐之后的全体员工会议时，我知道我的决定是对的。

sentences.en: After a couple of weeks of watching the daily sales dwindle, a $12,141 Saturday to a $4,188 Monday to a $2,093 Thursday, it was a relief to decide to pull the parachute cord.
sentences.zh: 在连续几周看着日营业额不断缩水——从周六的12,141美元跌到周一的4,188美元，再到周四的2,093美元——决定拉开降落伞反而成了一种解脱。

sentences.en: I didn't want to have waited too long, didn't want to crash into the trees.
sentences.zh: 我不想等得太久，不想一头栽进树林里。

sentences.en: Our sous-chef FaceTimed in, as did our lead line cook, while nearly everyone else gathered in the dining room.
sentences.zh: 我们的副主厨通过 FaceTime 接入了会议，我们的主力热菜厨师也是如此，而几乎其他人全都聚集在餐厅里。

sentences.en: I looked everybody in the eye and said,
sentences.zh: 我看着每个人的眼睛说道：

sentences.en: I've decided not to wait to see what will happen.
sentences.zh: 我决定不等着看接下来会发生什么了。

sentences.en: I encourage you to call first thing in the morning for unemployment, and you have a week's paycheck from me coming.
sentences.zh: 我鼓励你们一大早就打电话申请失业救济，你们会收到我开出的一周薪水。

sentences.en: After the meeting, there was some directionless shuffling.
sentences.zh: 会议结束后，大家一阵毫无方向地走动。

sentences.en: Should we collect our things?
sentences.zh: 我们该收拾东西吗？

sentences.en: Grab our knives?
sentences.zh: 拿上我们的刀吗？

sentences.en: Stay and have a drink?
sentences.zh: 留下来喝一杯？

sentences.en: There was still one last dinner, so four of us,
sentences.zh: 这天还剩下最后一顿晚餐，所以我们四个人——

sentences.en: Ashley and I, our general manager Anna, and Jake, a beloved line cook, worked the last shift at Prune for who knows how long.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉和我、我们的总经理安娜，以及深受喜爱的热菜厨师杰克——在 Prune 完成了不知还要持续多久的最后一个班次。

sentences.en: Some staff members remained behind to eat with one another, spending their money in-house.
sentences.zh: 一些员工留下来互相陪伴着吃饭，把他们的钱花在店里。

sentences.en: As word trickled out, some long-ago alumnae reached out to place orders for meals
sentences.zh: 随着消息不胫而走，一些早年毕业的员工联系我们订餐，

sentences.en: from Lauren Coyce, who waited tables at Prune all through her Ph.D.
sentences.zh: 比如劳伦·科伊斯，她在读博士期间一直在 Prune 做服务员，现在是阿拉巴马大学的心理学助理教授，她订了：两杯黑黑暴风雨（Dark and Stormy）、凤尾鱼虾、炸牡蛎。

sentences.en: program and is now an assistant professor of psychology at the University of Alabama, two dark and stormies, shrimp with anchovy, fried oysters.
sentences.zh: 我们假装今晚是个特别之日。

sentences.zh: 特雷维索沙拉、鸭油土豆、带汤汁的豆子、

sentences.zh: 布列塔尼黄油蛋糕、两杯黑咖啡，外加50%的小费。

sentences.en: Breton butter cake, two black coffees, plus 50% tip.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉负责扒炉和冷盘档口，同时还要调酒和传菜。

sentences.en: Ashley worked the grill station and cold appetizers, while also bartending and expediting.
sentences.zh: 安娜负责迎宾、带位和接电话。

sentences.en: Anna waited and hosted and answered the phone.
sentences.zh: 杰克一个人包揽了所有的十个炉眼。

sentences.en: Jake worked all ten burners alone.
sentences.zh: 我系着黄围裙在洗碗区忙活、清理桌子、搬运收纳盆，当得知科伊斯的点单时，我有一瞬间忍不住哭了出来。

sentences.en: I was in a yellow apron handling the dish pit, clearing the tables, and running bus tubs, and I broke into tears for a second when I learned of Coyce's order.
sentences.zh: 餐厅里常把“家庭”挂在嘴边，这是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: The word family is thrown around in restaurants for good reason.
sentences.zh: 我们总共创下了1,144美元的营业额。

sentences.en: We banked $1,144 in total sales.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上员工们离开时，我们在屋里隔空挥手告别，带着一种渴望与白眼交织的奇异心情，

sentences.en: As our staff left that night, we waved across the room to one another with a strange mixture of longing and eye-rolling,
sentences.zh: 大家仍然处于不得不保持如此疏远的自我意识阶段，所有人对即将到来的一切都一无所知。

sentences.en: still in the self-conscious phase of having to act so distant from one another, all of us still so unaware of what was coming.
sentences.zh: 然后，就在我拖地前搬运最后一托盘玻璃器皿时，

sentences.en: Then, as I was running a last tray of glassware before mopping the floors,
sentences.zh: 阿什莉俯过身来宣布：

sentences.en: Ashley leaned over to announce,
sentences.zh: 嘿，他刚刚宣布了。

sentences.en: Hey, he just called it.

sentences.en: an old line cook trick for amplifying sound.

sentences.en: I texted a clip of her mini-operation to Jose Andres, who called immediately with encouragement.

sentences.en: We will win this together.

sentences.en: We will feed the world, one plate at a time.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉向我们的批发商下达了最后一笔大订单。

sentences.zh: 而我们的客户代表玛丽·埃伦娜·科雷奥——我们相识于20年我是她的第一个客户时，

sentences.en: And our account rep, Marie Elena Correo, we met when I was her first account 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 她出席了我们2016年的婚礼——甚至连清嗓子都没有，就把订单发了过去，将卡车派往了一家如今已经关门大吉的企业。

sentences.en: She came to our wedding in 2016, put the order through without even clearing her throat, sending the truck to a now-shuttered business.
sentences.zh: 她和我们一样清楚，这笔账要过很久才能结清。

sentences.en: She knew as well as we did that it would be a long while before the bill was paid.
sentences.zh: 莱奥来自我们已经合作了20年的家族经营肉铺——

sentences.zh: 皮诺优质肉类市场，他打电话来不是为了外交辞令般地打听我们的计划，而是直接提供实质性的帮助。

sentences.en: Pino's Prime Meat Market, called not to diplomatically inquire about our plans, but to immediately offer tangibles.
sentences.zh: 你们家里需要什么肉？

sentences.en: What meats do you ladies need for the home?
sentences.zh: 他提供这些帮助时，明明知道我桌上的一叠发票里有他30天的货款，总额高达数千美元。

sentences.en: He offered this even though he knew that there were 30 days' worth of his invoices in a pile on my desk, totaling thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 一整天，外面人行道上不断有街坊老主顾走过，隔着锁着的法式玻璃门向我们比着爱心手势。

sentences.en: And all day, a string of neighborhood regulars passed by on the sidewalk outside and made heart hands at us through the locked French doors.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，突然关闭一家餐厅是一项历时一周的全职工作。

sentences.en: It turned out that abruptly closing a restaurant is a week-long, full-time job.
sentences.zh: 我被铺天盖地的大量短信轰炸。

sentences.en: I was bombarded with an astonishing volume of texts.
sentences.zh: 电话整天响个不停，绝大多数都是送来祝福的人和充满遗憾的取消预订。

sentences.en: The phone rang throughout the day, overwhelmingly well-wishers and regretful cancellations.
sentences.zh: 但有一个女人显然没有关注新冠疫情的新闻。

sentences.en: But there was a woman who apparently hadn't followed the coronavirus news.
sentences.zh: 她打断了我的问候说道：喂，你们今天营业供应早午餐吗？

sentences.en: She cut me off in the middle of my greeting with, yeah, you guys open for brunch?
sentences.zh: 然后还没等我说完“保重”就挂断了电话。

sentences.en: Then she hung up before I could even finish saying, take care out there.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉花了将近三天时间整理冷柜，将易腐烂食品和步入式冷库里的东西分类，比如“今天吃掉正好”或者“这适合长期保存”。

sentences.en: Ashley spent almost three days packing the freezers, sorting the perishables and the walk-in into categories like, today would be good, or this will be good for the long haul.
sentences.zh: 我们试着用厚厚的一层鸭油将半熟的鸡肉封存起来，看看能否让它们在气味严实的棺木中完美保存。

sentences.en: We tried burying par-cooked chickens under a tight seal of duck fat to see if we could keep them perfectly preserved in their airtight coffins.
sentences.zh: 她腌制了甜菜根和抱子甘蓝，将几夸脱浓奶油搅打成黄油。

sentences.en: She pickled the beets and the brussel sprouts, churned quarts of heavy cream into butter.
sentences.zh: 我原本以为自己能很快解决其他问题。

sentences.en: I imagined I would tackle my other problems quickly.
sentences.zh: 我给银行经理发了电子邮件。

sentences.en: I emailed my banker.
sentences.zh: 为了营业税、酒水发票以及即将到期的房租，我希望能申请一笔小额信用额度来帮我度过危机。

sentences.en: For sales taxes, liquor invoices, and impending rent, I hoped to apply for a modest line of credit to float me through the crisis.
sentences.zh: 我想，过去二十年里每年经由我的银行账户流过250万到300万美元的资金，应该能让我很快获批信用额度。

sentences.en: I thought having run $2.5 million to $3 million through my bank each year for the past two decades would leave me poised to see a line of credit quickly.
sentences.zh: 但随后我想起我在过去一年里换了银行。

sentences.en: But then I remembered that I switched banks in the past year.
sentences.zh: 我行业里的每个人都鼓励我申请美国小企业管理局（SBA）的灾难贷款。

sentences.en: Everyone in my industry encouraged me to apply for an SBA disaster loan.
sentences.zh: 我行业里的每个人都鼓励我申请美国小企业管理局的灾难贷款。

sentences.en: I estimated we wouldn't need much.
sentences.zh: 我估算着我们不需要太多资金。
持续14天，五万美元。

sentences.en: So I sent in my query.
sentences.zh: 于是我提交了咨询申请。

sentences.en: In the meantime, I made a phone call to Ken, my insurance broker of 20 years, who explained in his patient, technical, my-hands-are-tied voice
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我给肯打了个电话，他是与我合作了20年的保险经纪人，他用那种耐心、专业、力不从心的语气向我解释

sentences.en: that this coronavirus business interruption wouldn't likely be covered.
sentences.zh: 这次冠状病毒带来的业务中断可能不在赔付范围内。

sentences.en: He intended to file for damages, as he would if this shutdown had been mandated because of a nearby flood or a fire, but he doubted I would get any money.
sentences.zh: 他打算申请赔偿，就像如果是因为附近的洪水或火灾导致停业那样，但他怀疑我能不能拿到钱。

sentences.en: That afternoon, I saw the courtesy email from our workers' comp carrier that the next installment of our payment plan would be drafted automatically from our bank in six days.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，我看到我们工伤保险公司发来的礼貌邮件，称我们付款计划的下一期费用将在六天后自动从我们的银行账户扣除。

sentences.en: Knowing the balance, I snorted to myself.
sentences.zh: 清楚账户余额后，我心里冷笑了一声。

sentences.en: Good luck with that.
sentences.zh: 想得美。

sentences.en: I called Ken about this, and he got them to postpone the draw.
sentences.zh: 我为此给肯打了电话，他设法让他们推迟了扣款。

sentences.en: And then, finally, three weeks of adrenaline drained from me.
sentences.zh: 然后，终于，积聚了三周的肾上腺素从我体内消退了。

sentences.en: I checked all the pilot lights and took out the garbage.
sentences.zh: 我检查了所有的长明火，把垃圾拿了出去。

sentences.en: I stopped swimming so hard against the mighty current and let it carry me out.
sentences.zh: 我不再拼命与强劲的水流对抗，而是任由它将我带走。

sentences.en: I had spent 20 years in this place, beginning when I was a grad student fresh out of school, through marriage and children and divorce and remarriage,
sentences.zh: 我在这个地方度过了20年，从刚毕业的研究生开始，经历了结婚、生子、离婚和再婚，

sentences.en: with funerals and first dates in between.
sentences.zh: 期间还夹杂着葬礼和初次约会。

sentences.en: I knew its walls and light switches and faucets as well as I knew my own body.
sentences.zh: 我对这里的墙壁、电灯开关和水龙头的熟悉程度，就像熟悉我自己的身体一样。

sentences.en: It was dark outside, when Ashley and I finally rolled down the gates and walked home.
sentences.zh: 外面天已经黑了，我和阿什莉终于拉下卷帘门，步行回家。

sentences.en: Prune is a cramped and lively bistro in Manhattan's East Village, with a devoted following and a tight-knit crew.
sentences.zh: 普鲁恩（Prune）是曼哈顿东村一家拥挤而热闹的小酒馆，有着忠实的拥趸和紧密团结的员工队伍。

sentences.en: I opened it in 1999.
sentences.zh: 我在1999年开办了它。

sentences.en: It has only 14 tables, which are jammed in so close together that, not infrequently, you put down your glass of wine to take a bite of your food
sentences.zh: 它只有14张桌子，挤得如此之近，以至于你经常刚放下酒杯准备吃一口饭

sentences.en: and realize it's on your neighbor's table.
sentences.zh: 就会发现盘子其实在邻桌的桌上。

sentences.en: Many friendships have started this way.
sentences.zh: 许多友谊就是这样开始的。

sentences.en: What was I imagining 20 years ago, when I was working all day every day at a catering job, while staying up all night every night,
sentences.zh: 20年前我在想什么呢？当时我整天都在做餐饮工作，而每天晚上通宵达旦，

sentences.en: writing menus and sketching the plating of dishes, scrubbing the walls and painting the butter-yellow trim inside what would become prune?
sentences.zh: 写菜单、画菜品摆盘草图，擦洗墙壁，给未来将成为Prune的店铺内部刷上奶油黄的饰边？

sentences.en: I'd seen the padlocked space, formerly a failed French bistro, when it was decrepit, cockroaches crawling over the sticky perno bottles behind the bar
sentences.zh: 我曾看过这个上锁的空间，它以前是一家失败的法国小酒馆，当时破败不堪，蟑螂在吧台后面黏糊糊的潘诺酒瓶上爬行，

sentences.en: and rat droppings carpeting the floors.
sentences.zh: 老鼠屎铺满了地板。

sentences.en: But even in that moment, gasping for air through the t-shirt I had pulled up over my mouth, I could see vividly what it would become,
sentences.zh: 但即使在那个时候，透过拉到嘴上的T恤大口喘着粗气，我也能清晰地看到它未来的模样，

sentences.en: the intimate dinner party I would throw every night in this charming, quirky space.
sentences.zh: 那是我每天晚上在这个迷人、古怪的空间里举办的亲密晚宴。

sentences.en: I was already lighting the candles and filling the jelly jars with wine.
sentences.zh: 我已经开始点燃蜡烛，把果酱罐装满葡萄酒。

sentences.en: I would cook there much the way I cooked at home, whole roasted veal breast and torn lettuces in a well-oiled wooden bowl, a ripe cheese after dinner,
sentences.zh: 我在那里做菜的方式很像我在家里做菜，整个烤小牛胸肉、抹了油的木碗里撕碎的生菜、饭后一块成熟的奶酪，

sentences.en: none of the aggressively conceptual or architectural food then trendy among aspirational chefs, but also none of the roulades and miniaturized bites
sentences.zh: 没有当时受雄心勃勃的主厨们追捧的那些极具概念性或建筑感的食物，但也没有那些卷肉卷和迷你一口酥，

sentences.en: I'd been cranking out as a freelancer in catering kitchens.
sentences.zh: 那些我作为餐饮厨房的自由职业者一直在赶制的东西。

sentences.en: At that point, New York didn't have an ambitious and exciting restaurant on every block, in every unlikely neighborhood, operating out of impossibly narrow spaces.
sentences.zh: 当时，纽约并不是每个街区、每个冷门的社区都有雄心勃勃、令人兴奋的餐厅开在不可能的狭窄空间里。

sentences.en: There was no eater, no Instagram, no hipster Brooklyn food scene.
sentences.zh: 那时没有Eater网站，没有Instagram，没有布鲁克林潮人美食圈。

sentences.en: If you wanted something expert to eat, you dined in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 如果你想吃点专业的，你得去曼哈顿用餐。

sentences.en: For fine dining with plush armchairs and a captain who ran your table wearing an Armani suit, you went uptown.
sentences.zh: 要想去有毛绒扶手椅、身穿阿玛尼西装的领班为你服务的精致餐饮场所，你要去上城。

sentences.en: For the buzzy American brossery with bentwood, cane-backed chairs and waiters in long white aprons, you stayed downtown.
sentences.zh: 要想去那种有着弯木椅、藤背椅以及系着长白围裙的服务员的时髦美式小酒馆，你得留在市中心。

sentences.en: There was no serious restaurant that would allow a waiter to wear a flannel shirt or hire a sommelier with face piercings and neck tattoos.
sentences.zh: 当时没有任何一家正经餐厅会允许服务员穿法兰绒衬衫，或者雇用面部穿孔、颈部有纹身的侍酒师。

sentences.en: The East Village had Polish and Ukrainian diners, falafel stands, pizza parlors, dive bars, and vegetarian cafes.
sentences.zh: 东村有波兰和乌克兰餐厅、沙三明治摊、披萨店、潜水酒吧和素食咖啡馆。

sentences.en: There was only one notable noodle spot.
sentences.zh: 当时只有一家引人注目的面馆。

sentences.en: Momofuku opened five years after Prune.
sentences.zh: Momofuku在Prune开业五年后开张。

sentences.en: I meant to create a restaurant that would serve as delicious and interesting food as the serious restaurants elsewhere in the city,
sentences.zh: 我的初衷是开一家餐厅，提供和城里其他正经餐厅一样美味有趣的食物，

sentences.en: but in a setting that would welcome and not intimidate my ragtag friends and my neighbors, all the East Village painters and poets, the butches and the queens,
sentences.zh: 但在一个欢迎而不是吓退我的三教九流朋友和邻居的环境中，所有的东村画家和诗人、假小子和酷儿，

sentences.en: the saxophone player on the sixth floor of my tenement building, the performance artists doing their brave naked work up the street at PS122.
sentences.zh: 我租住的公寓大楼六楼的萨克斯管演奏家，以及在街上PS122进行勇敢赤裸创作的行为艺术家们。

sentences.en: I wanted a place you could go after work or on your day off if you had only a line cook's paycheck, but also a line cook's pallet.
sentences.zh: 我想要这样一个地方：如果你拿着一线厨师的薪水，但也有着一线厨师的味蕾，下班后或休息日就可以去那里。

sentences.en: And I thought it might be a more stable way to earn a living than the scramble of freelancing I'd done up until then.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这可能比我之前那种东奔西跑的自由职业生活更能稳定谋生。

sentences.en: Like most chefs who own these small restaurants that have now proliferated across the whole city,
sentences.zh: 就像大多数拥有这些如今已遍布全城的小餐厅的主厨一样，

sentences.en: I've been driven by the sensory, the human, the poetic, and the profane, not by money or a thirst to expand.
sentences.zh: 我一直是被感官的、人性的、诗意的和世俗的东西所驱动，而不是为了金钱或扩张的渴望。

sentences.en: Even after seven nights a week for two decades, I am still stopped in my tracks every time my bartenders snap those metal lids onto the cocktail shakers
sentences.zh: 即使每周工作七天、持续了二十年，每当我的调酒师将那些金属盖“啪”地扣到鸡尾酒摇酒壶上

sentences.en: and start rattling the ice like maracas.
sentences.zh: 并像沙锤一样开始摇晃冰块时，我仍然会不由自主地停下脚步。

sentences.en: I still close my eyes for a second, taking a deep inhale every time the salted pistachios are set afire with Rocky, sending their anise scent through the dining room.
sentences.zh: 每当咸味开心果与罗基一起被点燃，将茴香味弥漫整个餐厅时，我仍然会闭上眼睛一秒钟，深深地吸一口气。

sentences.en: I still thrill when the four top at table nine are talking to one another so contentedly that they don't notice they are the last diners, lingering in the cocoon of the wine
sentences.zh: 当九号桌的四人谈笑风生，沉浸在葡萄酒的温馨氛围中，甚至没有注意到自己是最后一桌客人时，我依然会感到一阵兴奋，

sentences.en: and the few shards of dark chocolate we've put down with their check.
sentences.zh: 还有账单旁放着的几块黑巧克力碎。

sentences.en: Even though I can't quite take part in it myself,
sentences.zh: 尽管我自己无法完全融入其中，

sentences.en: I'm the boss who must remain a little aloof from the crew.
sentences.zh: 我是那个必须与员工保持一定距离的老板。

sentences.en: I still quietly thrum with satisfaction when the kids are chattering away and hugging one another their hellos and how-are-yous in the hallway as they get ready for their shifts.
sentences.zh: 当孩子们在走廊里为换班做准备时，叽叽喳喳地聊天，互相拥抱问好和寒暄，我的内心仍然会静静地涌起满足感。

sentences.en: But the very first time you cut a payroll check, you understand quite bluntly that poetic notions aside, you are running a business.
sentences.zh: 但就在你开出第一张工资支票的那一刻，你非常残酷地明白，抛开诗意的想法不谈，你是在经营一家企业。

sentences.en: And that crew of knuckleheads you adore are counting on you for their livelihood.
sentences.zh: 而你所热爱的这群笨蛋员工正指望你来维持生计呢。

sentences.en: In the beginning, I was closed on Mondays, ran only six dinner shifts, and paid myself $425 a week.
sentences.zh: 一开始，我周一闭店，只做六个晚上的晚餐服务，每周给自己发425美元的工资。

sentences.en: I got a very positive review in the New York Times, and thereafter, we were packed.
sentences.zh: 我在《纽约时报》上得到了非常积极的评价，从那以后，我们座无虚席。

sentences.en: When I added a seventh dinner in 2000, I was able to hire a full-time sous chef.
sentences.zh: 2000年我增加第七晚的晚餐服务时，我得以聘请了一位全职副主厨。

sentences.en: When I added a weekend brunch, which started as a dreamy idea, not a business plan, it wound up being popular enough to let me buy out all six of the original investors.
sentences.zh: 当我增加周末早午餐时，这最初只是一个梦幻的想法，而不是商业计划，但它最终广受欢迎，让我得以买断所有六位最初的投资人。

sentences.en: I turned 43 in 2008 and finally became the majority owner of my restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我在2008年迎来了43岁生日，终于成为了我餐厅的控股股东。

sentences.en: I made my last student loan payment and started paying myself $800 a week.
sentences.zh: 我付清了最后一笔学生贷款，并开始给自己每周发800美元的薪水。

sentences.en: A few years later, when I added lunch service on weekdays, it was a business decision, not a dream, because I needed to be able to afford health insurance for my staff,
sentences.zh: 几年后，当我增加工作日的午餐服务时，这是一个商业决定，而不是梦想，因为我需要为我的员工支付医疗保险，

sentences.en: and I knew I could make an excellent burger.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道自己能做出极棒的汉堡。

sentences.en: So suddenly, there we were.
sentences.zh: 于是突然之间，我们就这样开业了。

sentences.en: 14 services, seven days a week,
sentences.zh: 14个服务场次，一周七天，

sentences.en: 30 employees.
sentences.zh: 30名员工。

sentences.en: It was a thrilling and exhausting first 10 years with great momentum.
sentences.zh: 这是势头强劲且令人筋疲力尽的前10年。

sentences.en: But prune at 20 is a different and reduced quantity.
sentences.zh: 但迎来20岁的Prune是一个不同且在缩减的体量。

sentences.en: Now that there are no more services to add, and costs keep going up, it just barely banks about exactly what it needs each week to cover its expenses.
sentences.zh: 既然没有更多的服务场次可以增加，而成本一直在上升，它现在每周勉强只能赚到刚好够支付费用的钱。

sentences.en: I've joked for years that I'm in the non-profit sector, but that has been more direly true for several years now.
sentences.zh: 多年来我一直开玩笑说我身处非营利行业，但过去几年这变得越来越残酷地真实。

sentences.en: This past summer, at 53, in spite of having four James Beard Awards on the wall, an Emmy on the shelf from our PBS program, and a best-selling book
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，在我53岁的时候，尽管墙上挂着四座詹姆斯·比尔德奖（James Beard Awards），书架上放着我们PBS节目的艾美奖，还有一本畅销书

sentences.en: that has been translated into six languages, I found myself flat on my stomach on the kitchen floor in a painter's paper coverall suit,
sentences.zh: 已被翻译成六种语言，我却发现自己穿着油漆工的纸质连体防护服，面朝下趴在厨房的地板上，

sentences.en: maneuvering a garden hose rigged up to the faucet.
sentences.zh: 操作着一根连接在水龙头上的花园水管。

sentences.en: I'd poured bleach and palm olive and degreaser behind the range in the reach-ins, trying to blast out the deep, dark, unreachable corner of the sauté station, where lost eggshells,
sentences.zh: 我在炉灶后的冷藏柜后面倒了漂白水、棕榄洗洁精和除油剂，试图冲洗炒菜区深处、黑暗且够不到的角落，那里掉落了碎蛋壳、

sentences.en: mussels, green scrubbies, hollow marrow bones, tasting spoons and cake testers, tongs, and the occasional sizzle plate all get trapped and forgotten during service.
sentences.zh: 贻贝、绿色百洁布、中空的骨髓骨、品尝勺、蛋糕测试针、夹子，还有偶尔掉落的烤盘，它们在服务期间都被卡住并遗忘了。

sentences.en: There used to be enough extra money every year that I could close for 10 days in July to repaint and retile and rewire, but it has become increasingly impossible
sentences.zh: 过去每年都会有足够的额外资金，让我在7月份闭店10天重新粉刷、铺瓷砖和重新布线，但现在越来越不可能

sentences.en: to leave even a few days of revenue on the table or to justify the expense of hiring a professional cleaning service for this deep clean
sentences.zh: 把哪怕几天的营业额白白扔掉，或者证明雇佣专业清洁服务来进行这种深度清洁的费用是合理的

sentences.en: that I am perfectly capable of doing myself.
sentences.zh: 因为这完全是我自己有能力做的事情。

sentences.en: So I stayed late and did it after service.
sentences.zh: 所以我留得很晚，在服务结束后完成了这一切。

sentences.en: The sludge of egg yolk seeped through the coverall, through my clothes to my skin, matted my hair and speckled my goggles as my shock registered.
sentences.zh: 蛋黄的污泥渗过了连体服，透过衣服贴在我的皮肤上，弄结了我的头发，在我的护目镜上溅满了斑点，我感到了震惊。

sentences.en: It has always been hard.
sentences.zh: 日子一直都很艰难。

sentences.en: But when did it get this hard?
sentences.zh: 但究竟是什么时候变得如此艰难的？

sentences.en: Two weeks after we closed,
sentences.zh: 我们闭店两周后，

sentences.en: Ashley still had not got through to unemployment, and I had been thrice thwarted by the autofill feature of the electronic form of the loan I was urged to apply for.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉仍然没能打通失业救济热线，而我则三次被我被敦促申请的贷款电子表格的自动填充功能所阻挠。

sentences.en: I could start to see that things I had thought would be quick and uncomplicated would instead be steep and unyielding.
sentences.zh: 我开始看出，那些我以为会迅速而简单的事情，实际上将是严峻而顽固的。

sentences.en: No one was going to rescue me.
sentences.zh: 没有人会来拯救我。

sentences.en: I went into the empty restaurant for a bit each day to push back against the entropy.
sentences.zh: 我每天都会去空无一人的餐厅待一会儿，以对抗这种熵增。

sentences.en: A light bulb had died.
sentences.zh: 一个灯泡坏了。

sentences.en: A small freezer needed to be unplugged and restarted.
sentences.zh: 一个小冰箱需要拔掉电源并重新启动。

sentences.en: Eleven envelopes arrived, bearing the unemployment notices from the New York State Department of Labor.
sentences.zh: 十一封信件送达，里面装着纽约州劳工部发出的失业通知。

sentences.en: The next stack of five arrived a week later, and then another six.
sentences.zh: 一周后，又送到了五封，接着又是六封。

sentences.en: The line of credit I thought would be so easy to acquire turned out to be one long week of harsh, busy signals before I was even able to apply on March 25th.
sentences.zh: 我以为很容易获得的信贷额度，结果却是在3月25日申请之前，经历了整整一周刺耳的忙音。

sentences.en: I was turned down a week later, on April 1st, because of inadequate business and personal cash flow.
sentences.zh: 一周后的4月1日，由于业务和个人现金流不足，我的申请被拒绝了。

sentences.en: I howled with laughter over the phone at the underwriter in his explanation.
sentences.zh: 听着核保员的解释，我在电话里放声大笑。

sentences.en: Everything was uphill.
sentences.zh: 一切都举步维艰。

sentences.en: 21 days after we closed,
sentences.zh: 我们闭店21天后，

sentences.en: Ashley still hadn't been able to reach unemployment.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉仍然未能接通失业热线。

sentences.en: They now had a new system to handle the overload of calls.
sentences.zh: 他们现在有了一套新系统来处理超负荷的呼叫。

sentences.en: You called based on the first letter of your last name, and her next possible day would be a Thursday.
sentences.zh: 你根据你姓氏的首字母打电话，她下一个可能的日子是星期四。

sentences.en: If she didn't get through, she would have to wait until the next day allotted for all the M's of the city.
sentences.zh: 如果她没有打通，她就必须等到下一次分配给全城所有姓氏首字母为M的人的日子。

sentences.en: Links to low-interest SBA disaster loans were circulated, but New York City wasn't showing up on the list of eligible zones.
sentences.zh: 低息SBA灾难贷款的链接四处流传，但纽约市并未出现在符合条件的地区名单上。

sentences.en: I emailed my accountant.
sentences.zh: 我给我的会计师发了电子邮件。

sentences.en: This is weird.
sentences.zh: 这太奇怪了。

sentences.en: She wrote back with a sarcastic, smiley emoticon.
sentences.zh: 她回了一封带有讽刺意味的笑脸表情符号的邮件。

sentences.en: I believe it will be updated.
sentences.zh: 我相信它会更新的。

sentences.en: It's the government.
sentences.zh: 这就是政府。

sentences.en: They are only fast when they are collecting your taxes.
sentences.zh: 他们在收税时动作倒挺快。

sentences.en: The James Beard Foundation kicked into high gear and announced meaningful grants of up to $15,000, and with an application period that was supposed to last
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·比尔德基金会迅速行动起来，宣布提供高达15000美元的大额资助，申请期本应持续

sentences.en: from March 30th to April 3rd, but within hours of opening, it was overwhelmed with applications, and it had to stop accepting more.
sentences.zh: 从3月30日到4月3日，但在开放后短短几小时内，申请就铺天盖地，不得不停止接受新申请。

sentences.en: Ashley texted me from home that our dog was limping severely.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉从家里给我发短信说我们的狗瘸得很厉害。

sentences.en: This was the scenario that made me sweat.
sentences.zh: 这就是让我冒汗的场景。

sentences.en: A medical emergency.
sentences.zh: 医疗紧急情况。

sentences.en: We could live for a month on what was in the freezer, and I had a credit card that still had a $13,000 spending limit, but what if we got hurt somehow
sentences.zh: 我们靠冰箱里的东西可以生活一个月，而且我有一张额度还有13000美元的信用卡，但如果我们不小心受了伤

sentences.en: and needed serious medical care?
sentences.zh: 并且需要认真的医疗护理怎么办？

sentences.en: Neither of us was insured.
sentences.zh: 我们两个都没有保险。

sentences.en: My kids are covered under their father's policy, but there was no safety net for us.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们的保单由他们的父亲承担，但我们没有安全网。

sentences.en: Among us chefs, there have been a hundred jokes over the decades about our medical and veterinary backup plans, given our latex gloves and razor-sharp knives
sentences.zh: 在厨师同行中，几十年来有过无数关于我们的医疗和兽医备用计划的笑话，考虑到我们的乳胶手套和锋利的刀具

sentences.en: and our spotless stainless steel prep tables, but my sense of humor at that moment had become hard to summon.
sentences.zh: 以及我们一尘不染的不锈钢备餐台，但那一刻我实在很难挤出一丝幽默感。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, my inbox was loaded with emails from everyone I've ever known, all wanting to check in, as well as colleagues around the country who were only now comprehending
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我的收件箱里塞满了认识的人发来的电子邮件，他们都想问候一下，还有全国各地的同行，他们直到现在才明白

sentences.en: the scope of the impact on New York's restaurants.
sentences.zh: 疫情对纽约餐厅的影响范围之广。

sentences.en: Hastily, fellow chefs and restaurant owners were forming groups, circulating petitions, quickly knitting coalitions for restaurant workers and suppliers and farmers.
sentences.zh: 同行厨师和餐厅老板们匆忙组建团体，散发请愿书，迅速为餐厅员工、供应商和农民建立联盟。

sentences.en: There were surveys to fill out, representatives to call, letters to sign.
sentences.zh: 有调查需要填写，有代表需要打电话，有信件需要签署。

sentences.en: Some were turning their restaurants into meal kitchens to feed hospital workers.
sentences.zh: 有些人将他们的餐厅改造成食堂，为医护人员提供餐饮。

sentences.en: There was a relief bill before Congress that we were all urgently asked to support, but it puzzlingly left out small, independent restaurants, even as it came through pretty nicely
sentences.zh: 国会有一项救济法案，我们都被紧急要求支持，但它令人费解地将小型独立餐厅排除在外，尽管它对大型连锁店和特许经营企业

sentences.en: for huge chains and franchises.
sentences.zh: 照顾得相当周到。

sentences.en: The other option, the Paycheck Protection Program, would grant you a loan with forgiveness, I learned, but only if you rehire your laid-off staff before the end of June.
sentences.zh: 我了解到，另一个选择是薪资保护计划（PPP），它会给予你一笔可免除的贷款，但前提是你必须在6月底之前重新雇用被解雇的员工。

sentences.en: With no lifting of the mandatory shuttering and the COVID-19 death tolls still mounting, how could we rehire our staff?
sentences.zh: 在强制闭店命令没有解除且COVID-19死亡人数仍在攀升的情况下，我们怎么可能重新雇用员工？

sentences.en: I couldn't really use the loan for what I needed, rent for the foreseeable future, and the stack of invoices still haunting me in the office.
sentences.zh: 我实际上无法将这笔贷款用于我真正需要的地方——可预见的未来的租金，以及办公室里仍然让我揪心的成堆发票。

sentences.en: And right when I started to feel backed against the ropes, I got a group email from a few concerned former Prune managers who eagerly offered to start a GoFundMe for Prune,
sentences.zh: 正当我开始感到走投无路时，我收到了一封群发邮件，来自几位关切的前Prune经理，他们热切地提出要为Prune发起众筹，

sentences.en: inadvertently putting another obstacle in front of me, my own dignity.
sentences.zh: 无意中在我面前又设置了一个障碍：我自己的尊严。

sentences.en: I sat on the email for a few days, roiling in a whole new paralysis of indecision.
sentences.zh: 这封邮件我搁置了好几天，在一种全新的优柔寡断的瘫痪状态中翻江倒海。

sentences.en: There were individual campaigns being run all over town to raise money to help restaurant staffs, but when I tried to imagine joining this trend, I couldn't overcome
sentences.zh: 全城各地都在开展各种个人活动来筹集资金以帮助餐厅员工，但当我试图想象自己加入这一潮流时，我无法克服

sentences.en: my pride at being seen as asking for a handout.
sentences.zh: 那种被视为乞求施舍的自尊心。

sentences.en: It felt like a popularity contest or a survival of the most well-connected that I couldn't bring myself to enter.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是一场人气比赛，或者说是关系最广者的生存游戏，我实在无法让自己参与进去。

sentences.en: It would make me feel terrible if Prune was nicely funded, while the Sikhs at the Punjabi grocery and deli down the street were ignored, and simultaneously crushed if it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 如果Prune筹集到了丰厚的资金，而街头旁遮普杂货店和熟食店的锡克教徒却被忽视，我会感到极其糟糕；而如果没有筹到钱，我同时也会被击垮。

sentences.en: I also couldn't quite imagine the ethical calculus by which I would distribute such funds.
sentences.zh: 我也无法想象我将如何分配这些资金的道德计算方式。

sentences.en: Should I split them equally, even though one of my workers is a 21-year-old who already owns his own apartment in Manhattan, while another lives with his unemployed wife
sentences.zh: 我是应该平均分配，尽管我的一个员工是一个21岁、已经在曼哈顿拥有自己公寓的小伙子，而另一个员工则和失业的妻子

sentences.en: and their two children in a rental in the Bronx?
sentences.zh: 以及他们的两个孩子住在布朗克斯的出租屋里？

sentences.en: I thanked my former managers, but turned them down.
sentences.zh: 我感谢了我的前经理们，但拒绝了他们。

sentences.en: I had repeatedly checked in with my staff, and everybody was okay for now.
sentences.zh: 我曾多次与我的员工沟通，大家目前都还过得去。

sentences.en: It would be nigh impossible for me, in the context of a pandemic, to argue for the necessity of my existence.
sentences.zh: 在疫情的背景下，要我为自己存在的必要性进行辩护几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: Do my sweetbreads and my Parmesan omelet count as essential at this time?
sentences.zh: 我的甜面包（胸腺肉）和帕森乳蛋饼在这个时候算得上必不可少吗？

sentences.en: In economic terms, I don't think I could even argue that Prune matters anymore, in a neighborhood and a city now fully saturated with restaurants much like mine, many of them
sentences.zh: 用经济术语来说，我认为我甚至不能再争辩Prune是否重要了，在一个如今完全饱和了类似我的餐厅的街区和城市里，其中许多餐厅

sentences.en: better than mine, some of which have expanded to employ as many as 100 people, not just cooks and servers and bartenders, but also human resource directors and cookbook
sentences.zh: 比我的更好，有些甚至已经扩张到雇用了多达100人，不仅仅是厨师、服务员和调酒师，还有人力资源总监和食谱

sentences.en: ghostwriters.
sentences.zh: 代笔人。

sentences.en: I am not going to suddenly start arguing the merits of my restaurant as a vital part of an industry, or that I helped to make up 2% of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我不会突然开始争辩我的餐厅作为行业核心部分的价值，或者我为美国贡献了2%的

sentences.en: gross domestic product, or that I should be helped out by our government because I am one of those who employ nearly 12 million
sentences.zh: 国内生产总值，或者政府应该帮我一把，因为我是那些雇用了近1200万人的人之一

sentences.en: Americans in the workforce.
sentences.zh: 投身各行各业的美国人。

sentences.en: But those seem to be the only persuasive terms, with my banks, my insurers, my industry lobbyists, and legislators.
sentences.zh: 但这些似乎成了仅有的、有说服力的词汇，我的银行、我的保险公司、我的行业游说者以及议员们都在使用它们。

sentences.en: I have to hope, though, that we matter in some other alternative economy, that we are still a thread in the fabric that might unravel if you yanked us from the weave.
sentences.zh: 不过，我不得不心存希望，希望我们在某种其他的替代经济体中依然重要，希望我们依然是织物上的一根纤维，如果你把我们从织物中抽离，它就会分崩离析。

sentences.en: Everybody's saying that restaurants won't make it back, that we won't survive.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在说餐馆撑不下去了，我们无法存活。

sentences.en: I imagine this is at least partly true.
sentences.zh: 我想这至少部分是真实的。

sentences.en: Not all of us will make it, and not all of us will perish.
sentences.zh: 我们并非所有人都能挺过去，也并非所有人都会消亡。

sentences.en: But I can't easily discern the determining factors, even though thinking about which restaurants will survive, and why, has become an obsession these past weeks.
sentences.zh: 但我很难分辨出决定性的因素，尽管思考哪些餐馆会存活以及为什么存活，已经成了过去这几周里我挥之不去的执念。

sentences.en: What delusional mindset am I in that I just do not feel that this is the end, that I find myself convinced that this is only a pause if I want it to be.
sentences.zh: 我究竟怀着一种怎样的妄想心态，才觉得这并不是终点，才让自己坚信，只要我愿意，这仅仅只是一次暂停。

sentences.en: I don't carry investor debt.
sentences.zh: 我没有投资者债务。

sentences.en: My vendors trust me.
sentences.zh: 我的供应商信任我。

sentences.en: If my building's co-op evicted me, they would have a beast of a time getting a new tenant to replace me.
sentences.zh: 如果我这栋楼的合作公寓将我驱逐，他们想找个新租户来接替我可得费九牛二虎之力。

sentences.en: But I know few of us will come back as we were.
sentences.zh: 但我知道，我们当中很少有人能恢复原样。

sentences.en: And that doesn't seem to me like a bad thing at all.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这似乎并非坏事。

sentences.en: Perhaps it will be a chance for a correction, as my friend, the chef Alex Ray, calls it.
sentences.zh: 正如我的朋友、厨师亚历克斯·雷（Alex Ray）所说，这或许会是一个拨乱反正的机会。

sentences.en: The conversation about how restaurants will continue to operate, given the rising costs of running them, has been ramping up for years now.
sentences.zh: 考虑到日益上涨的运营成本，关于餐馆将如何继续运营的讨论多年来一直在不断升温。

sentences.en: The coronavirus did not suddenly shine light on an unknown fragility.
sentences.zh: 冠状病毒并没有突然照亮一个不为人知的脆弱群体。

sentences.en: We've all known, and for a rather long time.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都心知肚明，而且已经很久了。

sentences.en: The past five or six years have been alarming.
sentences.zh: 过去五六年令人触目惊心。

sentences.en: For restaurants, coronavirus-mandated closures are like the oral surgery or appendectomy you suddenly face while you are uninsured.
sentences.zh: 对餐馆而言，冠状病毒强制关闭就像是一场口腔手术或阑尾切除术，而你恰好没有买保险，突然就得面对这一切。

sentences.en: These closures will take out the weakest and the most vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 这些关闭将淘汰最弱小和最脆弱的群体。

sentences.en: But exactly who among us are the weakest and most vulnerable is not obvious.
sentences.zh: 但我们之中究竟谁是最弱小、最脆弱的，这并不显而易见。

sentences.en: Since Prune opened in the East Village, the neighborhood has changed tremendously in ways that reflect, with exquisite perfection, the restaurant scene as a whole.
sentences.zh: 自从Prune在东村开业以来，这个街区发生了翻天覆地的变化，完美地折射出了整个餐饮业的面貌。

sentences.en: Within a ten-block radius of my front door, we have the more than one hundred-year-old institutions,
sentences.zh: 在我家前门方圆十个街区之内，有那些拥有上百年历史的老字号，

sentences.en: Russ and Daughters, and Katz's Delicatessen.
sentences.zh: Russ and Daughters，以及Katz's Delicatessen。

sentences.en: We have
sentences.zh: 我们有

sentences.en: Hole-in-the-Wall falafel, bubble tea and dumpling houses, and there's a steakhouse whose chef also operates a restaurant in Miami.
sentences.zh: 街头小吃店、珍珠奶茶店和水饺店，还有一家牛排馆，其主厨同时也在迈阿密经营着一家餐馆。

sentences.en: There's everyday sushi and rare, wildly expensive omakase sushi, as well as
sentences.zh: 这里既有日常的寿司，也有稀少且价格不菲的无菜单料理（omakase），还有

sentences.en: Japanese home cooking, udon specialists, and soba shops.
sentences.zh: 日式家庭料理、乌冬面专卖店和荞麦面店。

sentences.en: There's a woman-owned and woman-run restaurant with an economic justice mission that has eliminated tipping.
sentences.zh: 有一家由女性拥有和经营、秉持经济公正理念且取消了小费制度的餐馆。

sentences.en: Bobby Flay, perhaps the most famous chef on the Food Network, has a 125-seater two avenues over.
sentences.zh: 美食频道（Food Network）最著名的名厨博比·弗雷（Bobby Flay）在两个街区外开了一家拥有125个座位的餐馆。

sentences.en: We have farm-to-table concepts every three blocks, a handful of major
sentences.zh: 每隔三个街区，我们就能看到农场到餐桌概念的餐厅，还有几家

sentences.en: James Beard Award winners and a dozen more shortlisted nominees, and an impressive showing of New York Times one- and two-star earners, including Madame Vo,
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·比尔德奖（James Beard Award）得主以及十多位入围候选人，更有《纽约时报》的一星和二星餐厅的出色亮相，其中包括Madame Vo，

sentences.en: a knockout Vietnamese restaurant just a few years old.
sentences.zh: 一家开业仅几年便惊艳四座的越南餐厅。

sentences.en: Marco Canora, who started the country's migration from regular old broth to what is now known by the name of his shop,
sentences.zh: 马可·卡诺拉（Marco Canora）开启了该国从普通老汤向现在以他的店铺命名的

sentences.en: Brodo, has published a couple of cookbooks and done a healthy bit of television in the course of his career.
sentences.zh: Brodo（肉汤）的转变，在他的职业生涯中，他出版了几本食谱，并做过不少电视节目。

sentences.en: He still runs his only restaurant,
sentences.zh: 他依然在经营他唯一的餐馆，

sentences.en: 17-year-old Hearth, on First Avenue.
sentences.zh: 位于第一大道、已经营了17年的Hearth。

sentences.en: But block after block for so many years now, there are storefronts where restaurants turn over so quickly that I don't even register their names.
sentences.zh: 但在这么多年的时间里，街区接连不断地出现一些店面，那里的餐馆更迭如此之快，以至于我甚至都记不住它们的名字。

sentences.en: If COVID-19 is the death of restaurants in New York, will we be able to tell which restaurants went belly-up because of the virus?
sentences.zh: 如果COVID-19是纽约餐馆的末日，我们能否分清哪些餐馆是因为病毒而倒闭的？

sentences.en: Or will they be the same ones that would have failed within 16 months of opening anyway from lack of wherewithal or experience?
sentences.zh: 还是说，它们本就是那些无论如何也会在开业16个月内因为缺乏资金或经验而倒闭的餐馆？

sentences.en: When we are sorting through the restaurant obituaries, will we know for sure that it was not because the weary veteran chef decided, as I have often been tempted myself
sentences.zh: 当我们翻阅餐馆的讣告时，我们能否确信，这并非因为疲惫的资深主厨决定悄悄从一栋燃烧了很久的建筑物的敞开后门离开——

sentences.en: in these weeks, to quietly walk out the open back door of a building that has been burning for a long time?
sentences.zh: 正如我在这些周里也常常产生这种诱惑一样？

sentences.en: It gets so confusing.
sentences.zh: 这变得太令人困惑了。

sentences.en: Restaurant operators had already become oddly cagey and quick to display a false front with each other.
sentences.zh: 餐饮经营者早已变得异常谨慎，甚至急于在彼此面前摆出虚张声势的姿态。

sentences.en: You asked, how's business?
